name: ceo-inbox-list
description: List recent messages from the principal's personal email inbox. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the principal's personal email, do not call from other agents.

inputs.folder: string? (Gmail folder/label to list, default 'INBOX'; use 'SENT' for the Sent folder, or 'DRAFTS' to list unsent drafts)
inputs.unread_only: boolean? (if true, only return unread messages, default true; ignored for DRAFTS)

outputs.messages: array of { id, threadId, from, to, cc, subject, date, snippet, unread, folders, attachments: [{ id, filename, contentType, size, isCalendarInvite? }] } (for non-draft folders)
outputs.drafts: array of { id, threadId, subject, to, cc, snippet, date } (returned instead of messages when folder is DRAFTS, alongside folder: 'DRAFTS')
outputs.has_more: boolean — true when more unread messages remain beyond this batch (lets the caller drain the inbox in batches); absent for DRAFTS
outputs.scan_incomplete: boolean? — true when paging stopped at the cap while more messages may remain. Absent when the scan finished. An empty batch still has has_more false, so the drain loop does not spin
